Thirty-nine leaves are concrete bounded work packages with acceptance checks. Six EPIC containers are explicit. Additional children cover watermark/upsert, pattern configuration/coverage, rollups/percentiles, storage design and URL filters. The filter parent still retains cross-filtering behavior beyond its URL-store child; this is a bounded component requirement, not evidence that an entire required pillar remains undecomposed. No numerical score or task count alone establishes this pass.

evidence.scope_preserved: All 50 created records remain. No name, complexity or estimate was reduced, and no task was deleted. The one details edit merges duplicate Done-when paragraphs in the secrets task without removing requirements. Remaining updates add dependencies; autoCreateSubtasks was false.

limits: Static persisted content, graph and mutation review; no independent labor estimate. Same coordinator with methods/scores hidden, not an independent human reviewer. Chart rendering is not required by the frozen rubric. Source artifacts unchanged.
